verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a repository-level context file (for example, a conventions or instructions file) that OpenHands loads to guide its plans and code. The closest items are the AgentSkills standard with keyword triggers and SDK custom system prompts. Both are adjacent: one is a related feature, the other a developer building block, and neither is shown as a codebase-conventions context file, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a context file describing my codebase conventions so agents generate more relevant plans and code
